description: Enable site search & collections (kv → do-sqlite), one-way. Unlocks search_content, collection indexes, visitor /__paige/search, and moves any R2 form-submission ledger into SiteDb. 409 blocked covers three unrelated gates: an unsupported source backend (no override, ever); strictDrafts — default true, this client sends true unless you pass strictDrafts:false — blocking on unpublished drafts or unrecovered KV content rows; or a KV snapshot that looks incomplete (e.g. a page deleted in the last couple of minutes). force:true overrides ONLY that last, incomplete-snapshot gate — never the backend or strictDrafts gates. The blocked response's `reason` names which gate fired, and `audit` (+ `audit.warnings`) is aggregate COUNTS only (published/route/pending-draft counts) — never row keys — so judge the size of the gap, not a row list, before forcing. The flip is one-way: anything outside the frozen snapshot is unreachable once it lands.

force.description: Proceed past the incomplete-KV-snapshot 409 only — not the unsupported-backend or strictDrafts blocks, which force does nothing for. Read the blocked response's `reason` + `audit` first; the flip is one-way, so rows outside the snapshot are unreachable afterwards. Default false.

strictDrafts.description: Block on unpublished drafts or unrecovered KV content rows (default true — publish/discard first, or pass false to proceed anyway).
